verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents built-in brute-force protection that temporarily or permanently locks a user account after too many login failures, so the brute-force part of the story is covered first-party. The pack has no evidence of bot defenses (e.g. CAPTCHA or bot detection) or of credential-stuffing-specific detection such as IP or distributed-attack throttling or breached-password checks. Missing for 10: bot/CAPTCHA protection, credential-stuffing detection, configuration depth of lockout thresholds, independent corroboration.
